_comment: Config for the Go60 HTML layout viewer (tools/gen-layout-html.py). Run `make html` after editing. Top-level keys are namespaced sections; underscore-prefixed keys are ignored.
_labels_format: labels maps a physical position to a custom legend. "POS": "text" relabels every layer where the key is active (skips transparent/blank). "POS": {"LayerName": "text"} targets specific layers only. Positions use the info.json scheme, e.g. R_C3R2. Labels may contain Nerd Font icons — the generator subsets an installed Nerd Font down to the icons used and inlines it, so the page stays self-contained.
_font_format: font (optional) overrides which Nerd Font supplies the icons: {"family": "Iosevka Nerd Font"} resolved via fontconfig, or {"file": "~/path/Font.ttf"} for an exact file. Omit to use the vendored tools/fonts/SymbolsNerdFontMono-Regular.woff2.
